mapper.sql: m.id, m.account, m.company_name, m.contact_name, m.contact_phone, m.region, m.audit_status, m.status, m.created_at, m.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shop s WHERE s.merchant_id = m.id AND s.is_deleted = FALSE) AS shop_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_operator mo WHERE mo.merchant_id = m.id AND mo.operator_type = 2 AND mo.is_deleted = FALSE) AS operator_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_operator mo WHERE mo.merchant_id = m.id AND mo.operator_type = 2 AND mo.is_deleted = FALSE AND mo.status = 1) AS active_operator_count
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant m WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_operator mo JOIN merchant m ON m.id = mo.merchant_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT mo.id, mo.merchant_id, mo.account, mo.name, mo.phone, mo.email, mo.shop_scope_type, mo.status, mo.created_at, mo.updated_at FROM merchant_operator mo JOIN merchant m ON m.id = mo.merchant_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY mo.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
SELECT mr.name FROM merchant_role mr JOIN merchant_operator_role mor ON mor.role_id = mr.id WHERE mor.operator_id = #{operatorId} AND mr.status = 1 ORDER BY mr.id
SELECT shop_id FROM merchant_operator_shop WHERE operator_id = #{operatorId} ORDER BY shop_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_operation_log mol JOIN merchant m ON m.id = mol.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant_operator mo ON mo.id = mol.operator_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT mol.id, mol.merchant_id, mol.operator_id, COALESCE(mo.account, '') AS operator_account, COALESCE(mo.name, '') AS operator_name, mol.action, mol.target_type, mol.target_id, mol.detail, mol.created_at FROM merchant_operation_log mol JOIN merchant m ON m.id = mol.merchant_id LEFT JOIN merchant_operator mo ON mo.id = mol.operator_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY mol.id DESC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET #{query.offset}
